My architectural approach enables a fluid transition between modular monoliths and microservices, always prioritizing component decoupling and software scalability.

item-agile-core: Through collaborative analysis of the development lifecycle and adherence to Agile standards, I focus on defining the priority and technical workflow of upcoming iterations. I serve as a bridge between requirements and execution, ensuring each development stage aligns with business objectives and the team's technical capacity.
